summary: Genius Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a share buyback of 6,037,851 Class A Ordinary Shares in a privately negotiated off-market transaction at a price below the recent NYSE American trading price, representing 27% of public float. Combined with a prior 6.6 million share buyback on June 15, 2026 and cancellation of 20 million shares on June 17, 2026, total 32.6 million shares removed in eight days. Board authorized the buyback on June 7, 2026; shares will be cancelled. The company targets removal of up to 43.3 million shares and seeks shareholder approval for a new 20% buyback mandate at the July 7, 2026 AGM. What to watch: pace of remaining repurchases and AGM vote; risk-arb angle negligible as issuer buyback is not a merger arb.
